jobs.name: diag-mooncake-dynamo-records-r1
args:
set -euo pipefail
while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "1790305092" ]; do sleep 0.2; done
export HF_HOME=/tmp/hf HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
cache=/tmp/hf/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
mkdir -p "$cache/snapshots" "$cache/refs"
ln -s /model/tokenizer "$cache/snapshots/nix"
printf nix > "$cache/refs/main"

test -s "$dataset"
artifacts=/shared/aiperf/results/diag-mooncake-dynamo-records-r1/$JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX
mkdir -p "$artifacts"
exec aiperf profile \
  --url "http://dynamo-frontend-reference:8080/v1/chat/completions" \
  --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct \
  --tokenizer Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct \
  --endpoint-type chat --streaming --use-server-token-count \
  --use-legacy-max-tokens \

  --random-seed 42 \
  --concurrency 128 --benchmark-duration 45 \

  --record-processors 16 \
  --output-artifact-dir "$artifacts"
